settings.heading:
Built for
the unknown.
settings.text: NØRTH started with a compass and a simple idea: make fewer, heavier, better things — for people who move differently.

Every Core Essential starts with dense, long-staple cotton — 320 GSM for our tees and up to 480 GSM for fleece. Garments are dyed and washed after they’re sewn, so they arrive soft and keep their shape for years.
The Graphic Series is our seasonal canvas: compasses, contour lines and coordinates drawn from the places we go. Each series is produced once, in a limited run.
Orders ship within 1–2 business days. Standard shipping is free on orders over $150. Returns and exchanges are free within 30 days for unworn items with tags attached.
